description: This file defines a utility class named 'Log' that provides logging methods and constants to facilitate logging at various levels. It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class, enabling configurable log output and chaining of LogNodes for extensible logging.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at different levels, abstracting Android's native Log class, and allowing chaining of LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode for subsequent log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message (overloaded for different parameters).
